name: Orthographic Multi-View Voxelization
definition: Rasterizes scene geometry into a 3D texture using three orthographic cameras aligned with the scene's bounding box axes to create a voxelized representation for subsequent volume rendering.
summary: Orthographic Multi-View Voxelization generates 3D voxel grids by rasterizing triangles into a 3D texture using three orthographic views, ensuring volumetric coverage without separate depth-buffer passes.
